source_refs.note: I. Screening and Sedimentation: a main subheading of 33.6 Wastewater Treatment, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 256-256.

blocks.text: The initial stage of water treatment typically involves screening and sedimentation. Large insoluble particles are removed by passing water through metal screens. This is followed by sedimentation, where water is held in large tanks to allow suspended solids to settle at the bottom under the influence of gravity.
